title: Career History
description: Explain the progression of your career with a clear chronology.
scenario: A hiring manager asks how your experience developed over time.
initial_question: Walk me through the most important stages of your career.
transfer_question: Which career transition prepared you most for your current role?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Keep the chronology concrete, professional and easy to follow.
